items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: when I was on that boat with St. Sun White in there. And we was playing ball out there one day... we was playing with the Den of Sheens in there, all of them, with the passengers and everything

ctx.x: Yeah William and on and all that bunch. See Lee used to teach a lot of them white boys. See how Louis Prem and them, Mom and them used to have groceries and things, bring them, put the sticks and stuff around there, show them how to make all them runs on the trumpet. What was it like being on one of those riverboats? Well, in the wintertime those folks used to carry cotton up in the Washtenaw River. See they would go from here to angle, branch off and angle, what they call the old river, through the Red River,…
